items.headline: Team Spirit do the double in Paris — CS2 kings win the Esports World Cup, donk named MVP
items.body: Team Spirit closed out the whole Esports World Cup by beating Türkiye's FUT Esports 3-1 in the Paris grand final. They dropped the opener on Cache, ground out two nervy overtime maps, then ran away 13-5 on Nuke to lift the $600K trophy. Nineteen-year-old superstar donk was untouchable — 88 kills, a 91.9 rating — and walked off with MVP.
items.say: Team Spirit just won that big Counter-Strike event in Paris — the kid donk was the best player there by a mile. You keep up with any CS?

items.headline: Wyndham Clark birdies the last three to hold off Rory — the BMW Championship is his
items.body: Clark took a five-shot lead into Sunday at Bellerive, wobbled with a few 'dumb bogeys' as Rory McIlroy charged, then slammed the door — birdies on each of the final three holes to win by three at 17 under. He heads to next week's Tour Championship with a real shot at the whole FedExCup.
items.say: Wyndham Clark birdied the last three holes to win the BMW and hold off Rory. The FedExCup wraps up next week — you follow golf at all?

items.headline: All-American in Cincy — Coco Gauff beats Pegula for her second title, no sets dropped
items.body: Coco Gauff cruised past fellow American Jessica Pegula 6-2, 6-4 to win the Cincinnati Open without dropping a single set all week — her second Cincy crown and fourth WTA 1000 title, joining Serena and Azarenka as the only women to win it twice in the Open Era. Perfect timing, too: the US Open main draw starts this weekend in New York.
items.say: Coco Gauff won Cincinnati without dropping a set — she's rolling into the US Open, which starts this weekend. Feels like it's set up for her.

links.text: WTA — Gauff vs Pegula final highlights

items.headline: Ninety-ninth minute! Szoboszlai's penalty rescues Liverpool at Newcastle in a wild 2-2
items.body: New Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola's first league game was a rollercoaster. Newcastle led through Anthony Elanga, Cody Gakpo levelled with a classy finish, sub Joe Willock nudged the Magpies back ahead — then, deep into nine minutes of stoppage time, Dominik Szoboszlai buried a penalty at the death for a 2-2 draw. Fulham-Chelsea tonight closes out opening weekend.
items.say: Did you see Liverpool nick a point at Newcastle with a penalty in like the 99th minute? Absolute chaos. Chelsea play tonight to wrap the first weekend.

items.headline: Cutdown week is here — and the Browns' QB mess is the one everyone's watching
items.body: The NFL's final preseason games (Aug 27-29) are the last auditions before rosters trim to 53 by Aug 30. The juiciest battle: Cleveland's Shedeur Sanders vs Deshaun Watson for the starting job, with drama in Indy (Richardson vs Leonard) and a four-deep quarterback room in Pittsburgh too. Real football is almost back.
items.say: It's NFL cutdown week — the Browns still can't sort out their quarterback, Shedeur Sanders vs Watson. Who's your team this year?

items.headline: Awards season lifts off — the Venice Film Festival opens next week with Danny Boyle's 'Ink'
items.body: The fall movie race kicks off at Venice on Sept 2, opening with Danny Boyle's 'Ink' — a juicy Rupert Murdoch/tabloid drama starring Jack O'Connell, Guy Pearce and Claire Foy — with Maggie Gyllenhaal presiding over the jury. Twenty films chase the Golden Lion, and Venice launchers have a habit of becoming Oscar frontrunners.
items.say: The Venice Film Festival kicks off next week — it's basically where the Oscar race starts. Danny Boyle's got the opening film. You catch many of the awards movies?

items.headline: Country owns the summer — Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' is 2026's longest-running No. 1
items.body: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' just keeps sitting on top of the Billboard Hot 100 — the longest-running No. 1 of 2026 so far — with Morgan Wallen's 'Been By Now' right on its tail. Country music having this kind of pop-chart takeover has been one of the year's real storylines.
items.say: Country's completely taken over the charts this summer — that Ella Langley song 'Choosin' Texas' has been number one forever. You into any country?

items.headline: A billion-dollar man — Bad Bunny becomes the first Latin artist to gross $1B on tour
items.body: Bad Bunny wrapped his most successful run yet — 3.1 million tickets and $467.5M from the 'Debí Tirar Más Fotos' world tour — pushing his career touring total past $1 billion, a first for any Latin artist. The wild part: the whole tour didn't play a single date in the United States.
items.say: Bad Bunny just became the first Latin artist to make a billion dollars touring — and he didn't even play the US. Kind of incredible.

items.headline: Wednesday's back for round two — Part 2, with Lady Gaga, drops Sept 3
items.body: Netflix's monster hit returns: after Part 1 landed earlier this month, the four final episodes of 'Wednesday' Season 2 arrive Sept 3 — and Lady Gaga guest stars as a legendary Nevermore teacher, Rosaline Rotwood. Jenna Ortega's deadpan detective is still Netflix's biggest English-language series ever.
items.say: The second half of Wednesday season 2 drops next week — and Lady Gaga's in it. That show is Netflix's biggest ever. You watch it?
